# TimSorter

`import "std/core"` (included in `import "std"`) · namespace `std.core`

The sorting algorithm behind [`Sort`](sort.md) and `Array.sortBy`: TimSort, a
stable, adaptive merge sort. It runs in O(n log n) time in the worst case and close
to O(n) on input that is already mostly sorted. It works directly on a raw buffer
(`T*`), so you normally use it through `Sort` or `Array.sortBy` rather than
directly.
